items.title: John LaPorta interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: I noticed a hundred of them were milling around wondering what to do. There were about 40 of them getting really taken care of by Herb Pomeroy and those people

ctx.x: When you started at Berklee, how large a school was it?

Well we had about 140 students. And I noticed a hundred of them were milling around wondering what to do. There were about 40 of them getting really taken care of by Herb Pomeroy and those people, and then these other people weren’t quite so good. I figured well this is the area I need to address. And the school I think has somewhere in the area of 2700 students, but it’s much broader now. There are all kinds of majors there and so forth. In fact they just recently started getting into a Master’s program there,…
Didn’t you perform with Teo Macero — is that how you pronounce his name?
